description:
Nothing is impossible for God. Matthew 21:22 says, “And whatever you ask in prayer, you will receive, if you have faith.” Why does it seem some prayers are answered while others are not?


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:


1.  I've heard that the wine in the Bible was not always fermented and alcoholic. How do we know if wine in the Bible was alcoholic or not? Specifically, when Jesus turned water into wine. Was the water Jesus turned into wine a fermented wine?

2. I recently watched a TV series called The Red Tent. I read Genesis 34 and it got me confused because my understanding was that Dinah was raped. Why does the Bible not say she was raped. It seems like Dinah did not protest. 

3. Since Every religion claims that their religion is the true religion, how do we know that Adventism is the true religion and that it isn't another religion that we should be following? What is the true religion?
 
4. In reference to Revelation 12:1-5, I have heard it said that the "woman" is the church and that the "Child" is Jesus, but considering that the "woman" was present before the "child", and Jesus created the church after He was thirty years old, who is the child if the woman is the church? Who is the woman and the child in Revelation 12:1-5?

5. I read in Revelation 7 that the 144,000 were to be sealed, assigned to tribes of Judah at that time. In the Old Testament, the 12 literal tribes were situated around the tabernacle, 3 on each side. Similarly, New Jerusalem has three gates on each side. Will New Jerusalem be situated in the same way, 3 on each side with the city centrally located? Are those of the great multitude also divided in 12 tribes? How will the New Jerusalem be situated?

6.  I hear other Christians say God told me this or that. How do I get the Lord to speak to me like that. How can I hear the voice of God?
 
7.  Will some people burn longer than others? I’ve heard people say they could not worship a God that would keep someone alive so that they could burn longer. 

8. I’ve learned that nothing is impossible for God, and Matthew 21:22 says, “And whatever you ask in prayer, you will receive, if you have faith.” If that’s the case, can God answer my unrealistic prayer if it is morally good but doesn’t necessarily have to do with God? Does God answer all our prayers?

9. Are there consequences if someone who believes in God, who does NOT drink alcohol nor smokes cigarettes but dates or even marries another believer who DOES drink alcohol or smokes cigarettes? Is it a sin to be unequally yoked?
 
10. Daniel 25:27 talks about a time, times and half a time. This is interpreted as being 3 1/2 years. Where in the Bible can you show that a time equals one year? Can you please explain Daniel 7:25?
